description: Main source file for DHCP Manager component, including initialization, signal handling, daemonization, and support for DHCPv4/v6 clients and servers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for DHCP Manager, handles initialization, signal setup, and main loop.

methods.name: cmd_dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches commands based on input characters, including connecting to bus, printing memory, and canceling.

methods.name: sig_handler
methods.description: Handles various signals, performs cleanup, logs, and stack trace on critical signals.

methods.name: _print_stack_backtrace
methods.description: Prints the current stack trace for debugging purposes.

methods.name: daemonize
methods.description: Turns the process into a daemon by forking, creating a new session, and redirecting stdio to /dev/null.

methods.name: is_core_dump_opened
methods.description: Checks if core dump size is non-zero, indicating core dump is enabled.
